articles.title: attune-ai 2.0.0
articles.summary: This news details AI-powered developer workflows focusing on cost optimization and pattern learning. These systems automate key software development tasks like code review, debugging, testing, and release management. Accessible via terminal or platforms like 'Claude Code', they aim to streamline operations, enhance efficiency, and deliver substantial savings in the development process.

articles.title: Defence Stock Watch: BEL, HAL, GRSE & others in focus today ahead of Union Budget 2026
articles.summary: The Union Budget 2026 is expected to heavily feature defence, with the capital expenditure (capex) allocation on February 1 being a critical indicator for national security and investors. This focus underscores India's commitment to modernising its armed forces and bolstering defence capabilities. SSB aspirants should monitor these allocations to understand strategic national priorities in defence spending and resource deployment.

articles.title: Mansukh Mandaviya, Indian Navy Chief flag off INHM 2026 in Delhi; Saina Nehwal, PR Sreejesh laud initiative
articles.summary: Union Minister Mansukh Mandaviya and Indian Navy Chief Admiral Dinesh K Tripathi flagged off the second Indian Navy Half-Marathon (INHM) 2026 in Delhi. This significant event, held at Jawaharlal Nehru Stadium, underscores the Navy's commitment to fitness, discipline, and community engagement. It promotes healthy lifestyles and strengthens civil-military relations, essential aspects for any defence aspirant.

articles.title: Israel to partially reopen Gaza's Rafah crossing
articles.summary: Israel will partially reopen the Rafah crossing, connecting the Gaza Strip and Egypt, after sustained pressure from humanitarian organisations. This move aims to facilitate aid flow into the war-torn region, though access remains restricted. The decision addresses urgent humanitarian needs amidst ongoing conflict, impacting regional stability and international relief efforts.

articles.title: Beating Retreat Ceremony: A Reflection of India’s Rich Military Heritage
articles.summary: The Beating Retreat Ceremony, held annually on January 29th at Vijay Chowk, New Delhi, concludes India's Republic Day Celebrations. It features a grand musical performance by the bands of the Indian Armed Forces, showcasing military precision and patriotic melodies. This event symbolizes the forces' return to barracks, marking the end of the celebratory period with solemn traditions and intricate formations.
